description: This file defines the Promote class within the Goteo project. It manages promoted projects, including retrieval, listing, activation, order adjustments, and validation logic. It interacts with project and language models to fetch localized data and supports operations like getting specific promote entries, listing all promos, and managing their order and active status.

classes.name: Promote
classes.description: Model class representing promoted projects within the Goteo platform. Handles database interactions related to project promotions, including retrieval, listing, validation, saving, ordering, and status management.

methods.name: getLangFields
methods.description: Returns the fields used for language-specific content, namely 'title' and 'description'.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a promote record by its ID, including localized fields based on current language.

methods.name: getByProjectIdAndChannel
methods.description: Fetches a promote entry for a specific project ID and channel.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Returns a list of all promote entries, with optional filters for active status and language localization.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Provides a list of promote entries with optional filtering, pagination, and count capabilities.

methods.name: available
methods.description: Lists projects available to be promoted, excluding current promotions based on project ID.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates promote object fields before saving, ensuring required fields are set.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves the promote object to database; inserts or updates as necessary.

methods.name: setActive
methods.description: Sets the active status of a promote entry identified by ID.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Moves the promote item up in order within its node.

methods.name: down
methods.description: Moves the promote item down in order within its node.

methods.name: next
methods.description: Calculates the next order number for a promote item in a node.

methods.name: getProject
methods.description: Fetches the associated Project object for this promote entry.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the textual status of the associated project.
